name: Eidolon
source:
The protagonist is a lost spirit who is given a second chance at life and at love by a sudden twist of fate. Will he accept his destiny or risk everything by challenging it?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250330005435/https://renai.us/game/eidolon]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一个迷失的灵魂。命运突然转折，赋予他重获生命与爱情的第二次机会。他会接受自己的宿命，还是冒着失去一切的风险发起挑战？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250330005435/https://renai.us/game/eidolon]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
